title: Prepare Gitea annotation packet
description: Evaluate go-gitea/gitea at pinned commit 0b1067484fcdc497dc34d9113c467182231e6ea9 as a Go identity, user-profile, and access-token corpus candidate. Verify repository identity and license, choose a manageable complete scope around models/auth/access_token.go and modules/structs/user.go, inventory every included file and exclusion, and prepare scanner-independent proposed annotations for applicable layers. Include positives, realistic negatives, ambiguities, evidence context, rationale, and provenance. Unsupported Go scanning must later report unread rather than a clean negative. Keep all annotations proposed pending human review.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Started scanner-blind source review for the next proposed packet: Gitea at 0b1067484fcdc497dc34d9113c467182231e6ea9. The exact commit and MIT license were re-verified. The proposed exhaustive scope is two authored Go files (170 and 137 lines): personal access-token storage plus API user representation. This adds Go, account identity, and credential semantics without duplicating the payment-card packet.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Prepared and materialized the scanner-blind Gitea packet. Complete scope: models/auth/access_token.go and modules/structs/user.go (307 lines total), 26 proposed data-item decisions. The worksheet separates direct token/account identity positives from verifier metadata negatives and link/free-text/image ambiguities. Manifest test passes; no label is accepted or counted.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Proposed Gitea packet is on develop via PR #5 (tests/benchmark/repos/gitea/). Closing this preparation sub-task. Acceptance remains DATAP-c66199.
